summary: First e2e run of Kazandıran. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (auth 401s, /me upsert with 5 credits, SSE generate start/delta/done with Claude ~15-25s, credit deduct, history list/detail/delete, cross-user 404 isolation, 402 at 0 credits, unknown tool 400 without charge, /packs enabled:false, /payments/initialize 503). Frontend: landing (hero tabs switch, 3 tools, 3 pricing cards, FAQ accordion), signed-out redirects of /panel,/gecmis,/kredi,/arac/listing to /sign-in, Clerk ticket sign-in, dashboard credit badge/banner/tool cards, session survives reload, listing generation streams into output-text with credit 5->4, copy/download/regenerate buttons present, copy writes the raw markdown to the clipboard, history row and detail, /kredi disabled notice with disabled buy buttons, 0-credit submit redirects to /kredi, required-field validation toast, sign-out, mobile 390px with no horizontal overflow. No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: Credit is charged before streaming. If the client disconnects mid-stream, asyncio.CancelledError/GeneratorExit is a BaseException and is not caught by 'except Exception', so the user loses 1 credit and nothing is saved to history.
On first login, if the Clerk email lookup (_clerk_email) fails, raise_for_status surfaces as an unhandled 500. A clean 502/503 with a retry message would be better.

integration_issues.issue: History.remove has no try/catch, so a failed DELETE leaves an unhandled promise rejection and shows no error toast.

issues: 'Giriş yap' and 'Ücretsiz başla' wrap onto 2 lines; add whitespace-nowrap or shorten/hide one CTA on mobile
Clerk UI is in English ('Continue to Kazandıran', 'Email address', 'Sign out') in an otherwise Turkish app; use @clerk/localizations trTR
After ticket sign-in the user lands on '/' instead of '/panel'; after sign-out from a protected page the user lands on /sign-in rather than the landing page (minor)

action_items: Optional: catch BaseException/CancelledError in the generate stream to refund the credit on client disconnect, or save partial output
Optional: add Turkish localization to Clerk (trTR)
Optional: whitespace-nowrap on mobile navbar buttons
Optional: add error handling to History delete
critical_code_review_comments: Generate refund path misses client-disconnect cancellation (BaseException)
_clerk_email failure gives a 500 on first login
payments.py: the callback flow and signature verification look correct (HMAC check, amount/basket match, idempotent pending->paid). It was not exercised because iyzico keys are missing (expected).
Model string 'claude-sonnet-5-5' works with the Emergent key (generation succeeded)
